section.content: Disclosed is a MOS-type semiconductor integrated circuit, which has: an input circuit section connected to an input pad; an output circuit section connected to an output pat; and an internal circuit section connected between the input circuit section and the output circuit section.
这里公开了一种MOS型半导体集成电路，该电路具有：连接到输入焊盘的输入电路部分；连接到输出焊盘的输出电路；接在输入电路部分和输出电路部分间的内部电路部分。

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly a kind ofly be configured for preventing input buffer because the semiconductor integrated circuit of the electric leakage that static discharge causes.

Background technology

When semiconductor device being assembled in the semiconductor packages or transporting, the partial interior element of semiconductor device can be because of static discharge deterioration or fragmentation.For the protection integrated circuit is avoided this damage; often constitute as semi-custom ICs such as grid array and standard cells; compound in advance several common transistor; input pad and o pads are not added differentiation; provide to have the input and output circuit that static keeps function, so that form the LSI design library easily.

For example, as shown in Figure 1, by the long p channel transistor 3,4,5 identical with grid width of grid and 6 and the long n channel transistor identical with grid width 7,8,9 and 10 of grid is provided in advance, constitute conventional cmos (complementary metal oxide semiconductors (CMOS)) type input and output circuit thus.

In input circuit part 15, p channel transistor 3,4 is connected between power line 16 and the input pad 1, and n channel transistor 7 and 8 is connected between ground wire 17 and the input pad 1.The grid of p channel transistor 3,4 is received power line 16, and the grid of n channel transistor 7,8 is received ground wire 17.

P channel transistor 3 and n channel transistor 7 constitute input protection circuit 50, and p channel transistor 4 and n raceway groove 8 constitute input protection circuit 51.

In addition, in output circuit district 23, p channel transistor 5,6 is connected between power line 16 and the o pads 2, and n channel transistor 9,10 is connected between ground wire 17 and the o pads 2.The grid of p channel transistor 5 and n channel transistor 9 is received internal circuit 20.P channel transistor 5 and n channel transistor 9 constitute output circuit 52.

The not contribution of signal of 10 pairs of circuit 20 outputs internally of p channel transistor 6 and n channel transistor, they constitute output protection circuit 53, and are the same with input protection circuit.

Utilize above-mentioned formation can realize containing the input and output circuit of electrostatic protection function effectively.

In recent years, the semiconductor integrated circuit capacity increases day by day.The thing followed is that operating rate improves.Yet, when utilizing silicification or autoregistration silication (salicidation) effect to reduce the dead resistance of diffusion layer to improve operating rate, cover the diffusion layer that is used for transistorized source electrode and drain electrode by refractory metal herein, electrostatic stress may be than more directly influenced diffusion layer in the past.Specifically, the leakage part subject to damage of n channel transistor.

Be head it off, for example, as shown in Figure 2, a kind of straightforward procedure of expecting easily is to insert resistive element 11,12,13 and 14 equably in the leakage part of n channel transistor 7,8,9 and 10.

Yet; about input circuit part 15; although inserted resistive element 11,12 electric current of n channel transistor 7,8 is restricted; prevent that thus n channel transistor 7,8 from puncturing; but because input pad 1 directly is connected with the p channel transistor 21 of internal circuit 20 and the grid of n channel transistor 22, the gate oxidation films of internal circuit 20 can sustain damage before protective circuit works.

For example, the Japanese patent application that relates to input protection circuit discloses the routine techniques that flat 9-97844 (1997) discloses a kind of head it off.As shown in Figure 3, in conventional input protection circuit 54, p channel transistor 3 is connected between power line 16 and the input pad 1, and n transistor 7 is connected between ground wire 17 and the input pad 1.The grid of p channel transistor 3 is received power line 16, and the grid of n channel transistor 7 is received ground wire 17.N trap resistance 11 is inserted between input pad 1 and the internal circuit 20.

In addition, about another routine techniques, for example Japanese patent application discloses flat 9-97844 (1997) and also discloses a kind of output protection circuit.As shown in Figure 4, in conventional output protection circuit 55, p channel transistor 6 and 10 series connection of n channel transistor, the source electrode of p channel transistor 6 is received power line 16, and the source electrode of n channel transistor 10 is received ground wire 17.The grid of p channel transistor 6 is received power line 16, and the grid of n channel transistor 10 is received ground wire 17.And, between the coupling part of o pads 2 and p channel transistor 6 and n channel transistor 10, be inserted with resistive element 13.Output protection circuit 55 is in parallel with output circuit 24.

Use the input protection circuit 54 of Fig. 3, can in internal circuit 20, realize input protection certainly.Yet, in circuit structure shown in Figure 3, owing to directly receive as mentioned above on the input pad 1 as the n channel transistor 7 of protection component, so, can not prevent that n channel transistor 7 from self puncturing.

In addition; if the circuit structure of input protection circuit 54 is applied to output circuit unchangeably; specifically; drive at height under the situation of output buffer output high level; because p channel transistor element function generally is lower than the n channel transistor; so the resistance of n trap resistive element 11 becomes very important, the output driveability is bound to become and is on duty mutually.When head it off, the layout area of output p channel transistor must enlarge, and therefore, can't realize the circuit structure that not only can be used for input circuit but also can be used for output circuit.So it can not be applied to grid array or standard cell unchangeably.

Because the cause of the output protection circuit 55 of Fig. 4 can realize the electrostatic protection of input circuit under the situation that the driveability that does not make output circuit is degenerated.Yet, in the circuit structure of Fig. 4, as mentioned above,, self puncture so can not prevent n channel transistor 9 because n channel transistor 9 is directly received on the o pads 2.Specifically, when resistive element 13 was relatively large, it is easier to be breakdown that n channel transistor 9 can become.Be difficult to select optimum resistance value.In addition, the pad of having nothing for it but provides output circuit 24 and output protection circuit 55 these two kinds of circuit structures.Therefore, these circuit right and wrong are multiduty, can not be applied to grid array or standard cell unchangeably.

Summary of the invention

Therefore, the purpose of this invention is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, can prevent that input buffer from puncturing because of static discharge, and can easily be applied to semi-custom IC, for example grid array and standard cell.

According to the present invention, a kind of mos semiconductor integrated circuit comprises:

Input circuit part, it comprise n channel transistor, p channel transistor and be connected on the n channel transistor and the p channel transistor between protective resistance; Wherein the importation is connected between p channel transistor and the protective resistance, and output is connected between n channel transistor and the protective resistance.

According to another aspect of the present invention, a kind of mos semiconductor integrated circuit comprises:

Receive the input circuit part of input pad;

Receive the output circuit part of o pads; And

Be connected on the internal circuit between input circuit part and the output circuit part;

Wherein input circuit part comprise a n channel transistor, a p channel transistor and be connected on a n channel transistor and a p channel transistor between first protective resistance, the input pad is connected between a p channel transistor and first protective resistance, and internal circuit partly is connected between a n channel transistor and first protective resistance; Output circuit part comprise the 2nd n channel transistor, the 2nd p channel transistor and be connected on the 2nd n channel transistor and the 2nd p channel transistor between second protective resistance; o pads is connected between the 2nd p channel transistor and second protective resistance, and internal circuit is partly received the 2nd n channel transistor and the 2nd p channel transistor.

Embodiment

Below in conjunction with description of drawings the preferred embodiments of the present invention.Fig. 5 is a circuit diagram of showing the semiconductor integrated circuit of first preferred embodiment of the invention.

By the first embodiment of the present invention; for example; as shown in Figure 5; by providing grid the long p channel transistor 3,4,5 and 6 identical in advance with grid width; the long n channel transistor 7,8,9 and 10 identical of grid, and n trap resistive element 11,12,13 and 14 with grid width, and with they combinations; constitute the input and output circuit with static road defencive function thus, these transistors and resistance are respectively applied for the input and output pad.

In input circuit part 15, p channel transistor 3 and 4 is connected between power line 16 and the input pad 1.N channel transistor 7 and n trap resistive element 11 reach n channel transistor 8 and n trap resistive element 12 and are connected on respectively between ground wire 17 and the input pad 1.The grid of p channel transistor 3,4 is received power line 16, and the grid of n channel transistor 7,8 is received ground wire 17.

P channel transistor 3, n channel transistor 7 and n trap resistive element 11 constitute input protection circuit 18.In addition, p channel transistor 4, n channel transistor 8 and n trap resistive element 12 constitute input protection circuit 19.

The input of internal circuit 20, for example grid of the n channel transistor 22 of the grid of the p channel transistor 21 of internal circuit 20 and internal circuit 20 are received in the coupling part that n channel transistor 8 in the input protection circuit 19 and n trap resistive element are 12.

On the other hand, in output circuit part 23, p channel transistor 5,6 is connected between power line 16 and the o pads 2.N channel transistor 9 and n trap resistive element 13 are connected between ground wire 17 and the o pads 2.The grid of p channel transistor 5 and n channel transistor 9 is received internal circuit 20.

P channel transistor 5, n channel transistor 9 and n trap resistive element 13 constitute output circuit 24.In addition, p channel transistor 6, n channel transistor 10 and n trap resistive element 14 constitute output protection circuit 25.

Below with reference to Fig. 5 this embodiment working condition is described.For example, when the negative voltage that is applied to ground wire 17 was added to input pad 1 or o pads 2, n channel transistor 7,8,9 and 10 punctured by resistive element 11,12,13 and 14, is used for extra voltage is imported ground wire 17.In this case, because the input of internal circuit 20 connects by resistive element 12, becoming by the puncture voltage that is designed so that n channel transistor 12 is lower than the voltage of inner grid, and protective circuit works before can puncturing at the gate oxidation films of internal circuit 20 certainly.

Fig. 6 is a layout of showing the first embodiment semiconductor integrated circuit, and Fig. 7 is the profile of getting along the A-A ' line of Fig. 6.

What this embodiment adopted is such example, n type diffusion layer district 28,29 and 30 disilicide layer use grid 26,27 to keep apart, channel length for example is 0.3 micron of the minimum dimension of semiconductor fabrication process, forms n trap resistance 11,12 by the n well region 32 that is incorporated in the p type substrate 31.

Form device by the district of the LOCOS (local oxidation of silicon) on the p type substrate 31 33 and form the district.Form in the district at device, form n channel transistor 8 by grid 34, n type diffusion layer source region 35 and n type diffusion layer drain region 28.In addition, form n channel transistor 8 by grid 36, n type diffusion layer source region 37 and n type diffusion layer drain region 30.N type diffusion layer source region 35,37 respectively by contact 38,39 and ground floor aluminium wiring 40,41 be connected to ground wire 17.

The drain region 28,30 of n channel transistor 7,8 is connected in series to n trap resistance 11,12 respectively, and by contact 42 and ground floor aluminium wiring 43 receive input pad 1.

In addition, the grid 26,27 of isolating disilicide layer is connected to ground floor aluminium wiring 43 by contacting 44, and the grid 34,36 of n channel transistor 7,8 is connected to ground wire 17 by contacting 45,46 and first aluminium wiring 40,41.Input signal from input protection circuit 12 passes through n trap resistive element 12, and internal circuit 20 is received in the drain region 28 of n channel transistor 8, contact 47 and ground floor aluminium wiring 48.

In order to constitute output protection circuit 25, ground floor aluminium wiring 43 have to be connected to o pads 2, disconnects the contact 47 that is used to connect internal circuit 204 simultaneously.

For constituting output circuit 24, grid 45,46 have to be connected to internal circuit 20.So, only, just can easily provide good input protection circuit by changing wiring.

Simultaneously, in Fig. 6 and 7, saved the processing step that forms behind the interlayer dielectric.

Fig. 8 is a layout of showing the semiconductor integrated circuit of second preferred embodiment of the invention, and Fig. 9 is the profile of getting along the B-B ' line of Fig. 8.

The second embodiment circuit structure is identical with first embodiment with working condition, following to illustrate concrete member among second embodiment by Figure 4 and 5.

As shown in Figure 4, in a second embodiment, replace the disilicide layer of gate isolation n type diffusion layer district 28,29 and 30 by the LOCOS district 49 that is used to form device region.Form n trap resistance 11,12 by the n well region 32 that is incorporated in the p type substrate 31.Simultaneously, other member is basically the same as those in the first embodiment.

By the present invention, offer internal circuit from the input of outside by protective resistance, even increase because of protective circuit at the electrostatic breakdown voltage of n channel transistor, and the n channel transistor to become under the situation about puncturing hardly also be like this.Therefore, protective circuit can work before the punctures such as gate oxidation films in internal circuit, so can carry out electrostatic protection effectively.So can improve the reliability of semiconductor integrated circuit.

In addition, owing to can realize that the circuit structure of electrostatic protection function both had been applicable to that input circuit also was applicable to output circuit, constitute so the input and output circuit can only pass through to change distributing, and can not increase layout area.So can easily be applied to as semi-custom ICs such as grid array and standard cells,
